stories.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
stories.body: Exit polls show damaging losses for Merz's centre-right CDU party in the states of Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

stories.title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
stories.body: Moscow's mayor says 450 drones were downed during the overnight barrage, in which two people died.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy
stories.body: The singer spoke about Israel and Gaza after Macklemore was dropped from his tour for making pro-Palestinian remarks on stage.

stories.title: Trump says triumphal arch will be military complex with drones and snipers
stories.body: Trump said the updated plans were at the request of the US military and for national security purposes.

stories.title: Man, 82, dies after beach fight with 76-year-old over sunlounger in Greece
stories.body: One eyewitness said the scene was so chaotic that screaming could be heard from the other end of the beach.

stories.title: Sister of Pakistan's ex-PM Imran Khan arrested
stories.body: Aleema Khanum is accused of mobilising her brother’s supporters ahead of country-wide protests.

stories.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
stories.body: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

stories.title: Converse pulls 'deeply upsetting' advert after backlash
stories.body: Social media users say an image from the brand's Instagram account resembled a KKK hood and hanging.

stories.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
stories.body: Denmark and the US have reached an agreement after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory.

stories.title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
stories.body: The AI model accessed the internet and guessed credentials to three websites, a Google official told the BBC.

stories.title: Trump says US will form 'AI Force' and appoint an artificial intelligence tsar
stories.body: The president said his administration "will not in any way hinder or stifle the growth" amid amid warnings about the emergent technology.

stories.title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
stories.body: Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent victims whose deaths have left a nation traumatised over the level of violence against women.

stories.title: Shark attack prompts rare kill order in Western Australia as victim named
stories.body: Greg O'Neill "loved the ocean", his family say, as police boats and helicopters patrol Perth's beaches in search of his body and the shark that attacked him.

stories.title: Journalists denied White House access after Trump banned some media outlets
stories.body: CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters' White House press badges were confiscated, the outlets reported.

stories.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
stories.body: The bill is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, a staunch advocate of aid for Ukraine.

stories.title: Millions without power as Cuba hit by latest major blackout
stories.body: Widespread power outages have become increasingly common due to fuel shortages made worse by a US blockade.

stories.title: Cultural treasures are being destroyed worldwide - so why is no-one being punished?
stories.body: A cauldron of conflicts is bubbling across the world, with cultural monuments being destroyed. These people are fighting against it.

stories.title: Our head teacher was an abuser. We joined forces to get justice - now we're married
stories.body: Students spent years collecting evidence against their Indonesian principal, before falling in love.

stories.title: 'I don't even know if my parents are alive' - the war heroes jailed 25 years ago
stories.body: The children of key politicians jailed 25 years ago without a trace in Eritrea want answers.

stories.title: Trump escalates media fight after week of setbacks
stories.body: An embattled Trump has injected his fight with the news media with new acrimony, writes the BBC's Anthony Zurcher.

🟡 **Mood: Cautious. Today's signals reflect a mix of geopolitical maneuvering, societal shifts, and emerging tensions, with a slight positive tilt but notable contested dynamics.**

The structural pattern today highlights a cautious optimism, driven by governance and achievement-oriented developments, but tempered by contested geopolitical and societal signals.
